RESPONSE TO PLTFS' OBJECTIONS TO THE PROPOSED SECOND AND SUPPLEMENTAL STATEMENT OF DECISION FILED BY DEFENDANT VIERLING, JAMES GABRIEL

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FLYING DUTCHMAN PARK INC $363,843.59 PRINCIPAL, $367,830.55 INTEREST, TOTAL JUDGMENT $731,674.14, REMITTITUR REVERSED JUDGMENT OF FEB-18-2003. PREJUDGMENT INTEREST OF $367,830.55 THROUGH MAR-31-2005, PLUS $108.74 PER DAY IN PREJUDGMENT INTEREST THEREAFTER, UNTIL THE DATE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF CCSF IS AWARDED ITS STATUTORY COSTS AGAINST DEFENDANT FLYING DUTCHMAN, INCLUDING ITS COSTS ON APPEAL, IN AN AMOUNT ACCORDING TO PROOF. AFTER JUDGMENT IS ENTERED, INTEREST SHALL ACCRUE AT THE RATE OF TEN (10) PERCENT PER ANNUM ON THE ENTIRE AMOUNT OF THE JUDGMENT. CCSF SHALL TAKE NOTHING BY WAY OF ITS COMPLAINT AGAINST DEFENDANT JAMES VIERLING, WHO IS HEREBY DISMISSED FROM THIS ACTION. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FLYING DUTCHMAN PARK INC $363,843.59 PRINCIPAL, $367,830.55 INTEREST, TOTAL JUDGMENT $731,674.14, REMITTITUR REVERSED JUDGMENT OF FEB-18-2003. PREJUDGMENT INTEREST OF $367,830.55 THROUGH MAR-31-2005, PLUS $108.74 PER DAY IN PREJUDGMENT INTEREST THEREAFTER, UNTIL THE DATE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF CCSF IS AWARDED ITS STATUTORY COSTS AGAINST DEFENDANT FLYING DUTCHMAN, INCLUDING ITS COSTS ON APPEAL, IN AN AMOUNT ACCORDING TO PROOF. AFTER JUDGMENT IS ENTERED, INTEREST SHALL ACCRUE AT THE RATE OF TEN (10) PERCENT PER ANNUM ON THE ENTIRE AMOUNT OF THE JUDGMENT. CCSF SHALL TAKE NOTHING BY WAY OF ITS COMPLAINT AGAINST DEFENDANT JAMES VIERLING, WHO IS HEREBY DISMISSED FROM THIS ACTION. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT.
